# Security policy

Security fixes are made on `main` and delivered through new releases. Use the latest published release when available. Development builds and old release lines do not receive separate backports.

Report vulnerabilities privately to **truongleanhvu20052004@gmail.com** with the subject **Drive Markdown Reader security report**. Include the affected version or commit, browser version, impact, and a minimal description. Use redacted data and omit credentials and private Drive URLs. Coordinate disclosure with the maintainer before posting details publicly.

Use the public issue tracker for ordinary bugs. See the [privacy guide](../docs/guides/PRIVACY.md) for data handling.
